note: Figures are as reported in the company's own filings and describe the periods shown, not the present. SEC publishes them within about a minute of a filing; they are not real-time data.

metrics.label: Revenue
metrics.definition: Total revenue as reported. The tag changed with the 2018 revenue standard; each value names the tag it came from.
metrics.missing_reason: Quarterly reports give this only as year-to-date totals. This view does not subtract periods to derive single quarters; see the annual view.

metrics.label: Gross profit
metrics.definition: Revenue minus cost of revenue, as reported. Many service and financial companies do not report it.
metrics.missing_reason: Quarterly reports give this only as year-to-date totals. This view does not subtract periods to derive single quarters; see the annual view.

metrics.label: Operating income
metrics.definition: Profit from operations before interest and taxes, as reported.
metrics.missing_reason: Quarterly reports give this only as year-to-date totals. This view does not subtract periods to derive single quarters; see the annual view.

metrics.label: Net income
metrics.definition: Net income attributable to the parent company's shareholders.

metrics.label: EPS (basic)
metrics.definition: Net income per weighted-average share outstanding.
metrics.missing_reason: Not reported under the US GAAP tag this view reads (EarningsPerShareBasic). The company may use a different or custom tag, or not report it. It is left blank rather than estimated.

metrics.label: EPS (diluted)
metrics.definition: Net income per share including the effect of options and convertibles.
metrics.missing_reason: Not reported under the US GAAP tag this view reads (EarningsPerShareDiluted). The company may use a different or custom tag, or not report it. It is left blank rather than estimated.

metrics.label: Cash and equivalents
metrics.definition: Balance at period end. When only the second tag is reported, the figure includes restricted cash; the tag is shown with every value.
metrics.missing_reason: Not reported under the US GAAP tags this view reads (CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue, CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents). The company may use a different or custom tag, or not report it. It is left blank rather than estimated.

metrics.label: Total liabilities
metrics.definition: Balance at period end. Some companies never report a total; it is not derived from other lines here.
metrics.missing_reason: Not reported under the US GAAP tag this view reads (Liabilities). The company may use a different or custom tag, or not report it. It is left blank rather than estimated.

metrics.label: Operating cash flow
metrics.definition: Net cash provided by (used in) operating activities.
metrics.missing_reason: Not reported under the US GAAP tag this view reads (NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities). The company may use a different or custom tag, or not report it. It is left blank rather than estimated.

metrics.label: Capital expenditures
metrics.definition: Cash paid for property, plant, and equipment, reported as a positive payment. The second tag is broader and is used only when the first is absent.
metrics.missing_reason: Not reported under the US GAAP tags this view reads (PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets). The company may use a different or custom tag, or not report it. It is left blank rather than estimated.

derived.label: Gross margin
derived.definition: Gross profit divided by revenue for the same period.
derived.caveat: Margins differ structurally across industries; compare a company with its own history rather than with unrelated businesses.
derived.missing_reason: Needs gross profit and revenue, which this view does not have.

derived.label: Operating margin
derived.definition: Operating income divided by revenue for the same period.
derived.caveat: One-off charges in a single period can move it sharply; read it across several periods.
derived.missing_reason: Needs operating income and revenue, which this view does not have.

derived.label: Net margin
derived.definition: Net income divided by revenue for the same period.
derived.caveat: Includes taxes, interest, and non-operating items, which can dominate in some years.
derived.missing_reason: Needs revenue, which this view does not have.

derived.label: Free cash flow
derived.definition: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures, both as reported for the same period.
derived.caveat: A common non-GAAP measure that companies define differently; this is the plain difference of the two reported lines, not any company's own figure.
derived.missing_reason: Needs operating cash flow and capital expenditures, which this view does not have.

derived.label: Liabilities / assets
derived.definition: Total liabilities divided by total assets at the same balance-sheet date.
derived.caveat: Shows how much of the balance sheet is funded by obligations rather than equity; banks and insurers run structurally high ratios.
derived.missing_reason: Needs total liabilities, which this view does not have.
